items.question: What is VideoClaw?
items.answer: VideoClaw is an AI YouTube video summarizer and transcript search workspace. It helps you generate a youtube summary, search the full transcript, jump to exact timestamps, and ask follow-up questions about the video.

items.question: Is VideoClaw just another YouTube summary tool?
items.answer: No. VideoClaw combines youtube ai summary, transcript search, timestamp navigation, and transcript-grounded chat instead of stopping at a short generic summary.

items.question: How does VideoClaw generate a YouTube AI summary?
items.answer: VideoClaw analyzes the video transcript and turns it into a structured youtube ai summary. You can then inspect the transcript and matched moments to verify the output.

items.question: Can I use VideoClaw for youtube summary with ChatGPT-style follow-up questions?
items.answer: Yes. After generating a youtube summary, you can ask follow-up questions about the same video and keep the answers tied to the transcript and timestamps.

items.question: Can I verify where the answer came from?
items.answer: Yes. VideoClaw is built to keep answers grounded in the transcript and linked to exact moments in the original video when possible.

items.question: How many credits does VideoClaw cost?
items.answer: Video analysis costs 2 credits per video (previously analyzed videos are free). In AI chat, Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite costs 0.25 credits per message, Gemini 2.5 Flash costs 0.5 credits per message, and GPT and Claude cost 2 credits per message. Subtitle translation is always free.
